facts.value: Non-prescribing NPs submit 15 contact hours of pharmacology every two years at renewal
facts.cite: Maine Board of Nursing, APRN FAQs
facts.quote: If an NP or CNM does not prescribe they must submit documentation of 15 contact hours of continuing education in pharmacology every two years

facts.value: Alternatively employed by a clinic or hospital with a physician medical director
facts.quote: or must be employed by a clinic or hospital that has a medical director who is a licensed physician

facts.value: CME prorated during the first licensure period
facts.cite: 02-373 CMR ch. 2 (Board of Licensure in Medicine)
facts.quote: CME will be prorated during the first licensure period
